overview: Before light the tables still carried three words, cloves, Yaxley with the question mark, and the lark. You had not slept since two. You did not wipe the leaf. You turned to a fresh sheet.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Read the three words, wiped nothing, and opened a fresh sheet.

assets.name: the writing-tables
assets.disposition: Read cloves, Yaxley, and the lark, and turned the leaf
